queries.query: रांची भू नक्शा खतियान कैडस्ट्रल प्लॉट नक्शा आधिकारिक झारखंड
queries.scope: Find official Ranchi plot-map and land-record services.
queries.result: Ranchi District Administration links the Jharkhand Jharbhoomi land-record portal. The Government of India service directory describes JharBhuNaksha as a Jharkhand government service for viewing land details and downloading digitized plot maps. Jharkhand State GIS also lists a Ranchi Smart Map, but its listing is general urban GIS, not evidence of cadastral property layers. The BhuNaksha portal open timed out in the fetcher; no parcel identifiers or geometry were retrieved.
queries.executionMethod: Hindi-language search and review of Ranchi district and government service pages; attempted BhuNaksha page open.

queries.query: Ranchi official cadastral map land records Jharkhand BhuNaksha GIS parcel map
queries.scope: Verify city/district linkage and distinguish urban planning layers from cadastral maps.
queries.result: The Ranchi district page directly links land records to Jharbhoomi. The official government service catalog says the Jharkhand JharBhuNaksha provides digitized plot maps and details, while the state GIS directory separately lists Ranchi Smart Map. The official BhuNaksha endpoint returned a web-fetch timeout before an HTTP response; the Ranchi point’s exact town/ward/sheet and any complete polygon remain unresolved.
